definitions.ProperArc.Chains.ActualRegisteredSummari:
fun {n} [NeZero n] c r =>
  { s //
    ∃ word,
      RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run (ProperArc.arc c r) (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.singletonExecution n) word = s ∧
        s.origin.isSome = true }
definitions.ProperArc.Chains.SummaryParams:
fun {n} [NeZero n] {r} hr =>
  (_ : Fin (r - 1)) × (v : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Code (n - r)) × ProperArc.Chains.CodeFiberParams hr v
definitions.ProperArc.Chains.lastCheckpoint: fun {m} v x x_1 => Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => x ≤ m → ℕ) x (ProperArc.Chains.lastCheckpoint._f v) x_1

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.card_summary_sigma
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r ∧ r < n),
  Nat.card (ProperArc.Chains.ActualRegisteredSummaries c r) = ∑ _t, ∑ v, Nat.card (ProperArc.Chains.CodeFiberParams ⋯ v)

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.card_codes_by_last_checkpoint
targets.signature:
∀ (m b : ℕ),
  Nat.card { v // ProperArc.Chains.lastCheckpoint v m ⋯ = b } =
    if b = 0 then 1 else if b ≤ m then 2 * 3 ^ (b - 1) else 0

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.card_code_fibre
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r ∧ r < n) (t : Fin (r - 1))
  (v : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Code (n - r)),
  Nat.card (ProperArc.Chains.CodeFiberParams ⋯ v) =
    n *
      (n + (n - r) - ProperArc.Chains.lastCheckpoint v (n - r) ⋯ - 2).choose
        (n - r - ProperArc.Chains.lastCheckpoint v (n - r) ⋯)

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.card_code_fibre_full
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r ∧ r < n) (t : Fin (r - 1))
  (v : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Code (n - r)),
  ProperArc.Chains.lastCheckpoint v (n - r) ⋯ = n - r → Nat.card (ProperArc.Chains.CodeFiberParams ⋯ v) = n

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.card_code_fibre_sum
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r ∧ r < n) (t : Fin (r - 1)),
  ∑ v, Nat.card (ProperArc.Chains.CodeFiberParams ⋯ v) =
    n *
      ((n + (n - r) - 2).choose (n - r) +
        2 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n - r), 3 ^ (b - 1) * (n + (n - r) - b - 2).choose (n - r - b))

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.card_actual_registered_summaries
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) {r : ℕ},
  2 ≤ r ∧ r < n →
    Nat.card (ProperArc.Chains.ActualRegisteredSummaries c r) =
      (r - 1) * n *
        ((n + (n - r) - 2).choose (n - r) +
          2 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n - r), 3 ^ (b - 1) * (n + (n - r) - b - 2).choose (n - r - b))

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.card_actual_registered_summaries_short_complement
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n),
  3 ≤ n → Nat.card (ProperArc.Chains.ActualRegisteredSummaries c (n - 1)) = (n - 2) * n * (n + 1)

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.sum_codes_by_last_checkpoint
targets.signature:
∀ (m : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ),
  ∑ v, f (ProperArc.Chains.lastCheckpoint v m ⋯) = f 0 + 2 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.range m, 3 ^ b * f (b + 1)

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.actualRegisteredSummariesEquivParams
targets.signature:
{n : ℕ} →
  [inst : NeZero n] →
    (c : ZMod n) →
      {r : ℕ} → (hr : 2 ≤ r ∧ r < n) → ProperArc.Chains.ActualRegisteredSummaries c r ≃ ProperArc.Chains.SummaryParams ⋯

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.card_actualCodePlacements
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r ∧ r < n) (t : Fin (r - 1))
  (v : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Code (n - r)),
  Nat.card (ProperArc.Chains.ActualCodePlacements c hr t v) =
    n * (n + ProperArc.Chains.outsideCount ⋯ v - 2).choose (ProperArc.Chains.outsideCount ⋯ v)

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.codePlacementFibreEquiv
targets.signature:
{n : ℕ} →
  [inst : NeZero n] →
    (c : ZMod n) →
      {r : ℕ} →
        (hr : 2 ≤ r ∧ r < n) →
          (t : Fin (r - 1)) →
            (v : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Code (n - r)) →
              ProperArc.Chains.CodeFiberParams ⋯ v ≃ ProperArc.Chains.ActualCodePlacements c hr t v

targets.name: ProperArc.Chains.outsideCount_eq
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ n) (v : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Code (n - r)),
  ProperArc.Chains.outsideCount hr v = n - r - ProperArc.Chains.lastCheckpoint v (n - r) ⋯
